scheme_name: Scholarships For Higher Education Abroad To Meritorious Boys And Girls From Open Category
other_conditions: Candidate and the candidate's mother/father or guardian must be Indian citizens
Candidate and guardian must be residents of Maharashtra
Applicant must have an unconditional offer letter from the foreign educational institution
The foreign university/institution must be ranked within the top 200 by THE or QS
Scholarship is available for postgraduate, diploma after graduation, and PhD studies
benefits_summary: The government covers the full tuition fee, personal health insurance, subsistence allowance, and one‑time trip airfare.
